title: My first proper gameplay trailer, almost 2 months in
author: Cosmonan
selftext:
I have already posted here some times about the Dungeon Crawler game I'm currently developing.

The most recent addition is an elemental combo system, with field combos that bring different effects on enemies. This first trailer focuses on that.

The tools I've been using:

\- Codex: text, concept art, tutorial system

\- Claude Code: main orchestrator, UI, mechanics, MCP connection with external sources such as:

\- Pixel Lab: sprites, animations. Been using mostly with Aseprite plugin so I can also clean up sprites, and noticed better results overall.

\- Blender for 3D models and cleaning of 3D models generated on:

\- Meshy AI: 3D models

\- Unity: Main Engine 

What do you guys think about this trailer? Also open to any questions.

comments.author: maxhit_studios
comments.body: Congrats on getting a proper trailer out at the two month mark, that's a milestone a lot of us keep pushing back. The elemental field combos are a smart thing to build the trailer around since it gives people an instant hook beyond 'it's a dungeon crawler'. Also appreciate you mentioning the Aseprite cleanup pass on the Pixel Lab sprites, as a solo dev I've found that manual polish step is what makes AI-assisted art actually feel like it belongs to your game.

replies.author: Cosmonan
replies.body: Thank you! Yep, the game is not complete yet, I'm currently working on the tutorial, but I felt I had to start making some videos to begin the marketing phase.
